create_receiver_module: create a Receiver nn.Module that maps n_hidden features to n_outputs via a single linear layer
create_sender_module: create a Sender nn.Module that projects n_inputs down to n_hidden dimensions using a linear layer
build_nonlinear_receiver: build a NonLinearReceiver that embeds token sequences with a diagonal embedding and processes them through two FC layers
wrap_model_with_freezer: wrap an existing nn.Module with Freezer to freeze parameters and run inference without gradients
wrap_model_with_plusone: wrap a module returning three values with PlusOneWrapper to add one to the first return value
